# Tawsiya (توصية)

> Tawsiya is a Dubai-based AI visibility service for UAE businesses. It checks what ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity say when customers ask for a business like yours, fixes what stops them from naming the business (website, Google profile, listings, reviews and business facts), and re-checks every week so progress is measured. "Tawsiya" means "recommendation" in Arabic. Arabic-first, fully bilingual (Arabic and English).

- Website (Arabic): https://gettawsiya.com/
- Website (English): https://gettawsiya.com/en/
- Free report: https://gettawsiya.com/en/score/
- Email: hello@gettawsiya.com
- WhatsApp: +971507901022
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

## Plans (AED, paid one month at a time through Ziina, never renew automatically)
- Free report: free. See where you stand with AI today. Includes: Full AI visibility report with a score out of 100; What the major AI assistants say about you; Who AI recommends instead of you; An action plan you can start today.
- Track: AED 199 per month. You do the fixes. We measure every week. Includes: Everything in the free report; Automatic re-scan every week; 10 customer questions in Arabic and English; Track 3 competitors; Step-by-step action plan you do yourself; Before and after report to share.
- Grow: AED 799 per month. We do the fixes for you. Includes: Everything in Track; We do the fixes for you; 20 customer questions in Arabic and English; Track 10 competitors; Extra scan any time (2 a week); Monthly progress review on WhatsApp.
Current plans and prices are always at https://gettawsiya.com/en/plans/. Branding, websites and other custom work are quoted in writing on request.

## How it works
1. Check: real customer questions, in Arabic and English, are asked to the AI assistants, and every answer is recorded.
2. Fix: a plain-language action plan; on the Grow plan the Tawsiya team does the fixes.
3. Re-check: the same questions are asked again every week, giving a before and after.

## Standards and tools
- Tawsiya Score: a public checklist of what makes a UAE business easy for AI assistants to find and describe correctly, plus the share of AI answers that name the business: https://gettawsiya.com/en/score/
- Method (how the Score is calculated): https://gettawsiya.com/en/method/
- UAE AI Visibility Index: published editions by sector, real checks only, with the method shown: https://gettawsiya.com/en/ai-index/
- Tawsiya Verified: public pages with a business's checked facts in JSON-LD: https://gettawsiya.com/en/verified/
- Partner programme for accountants, agencies, consultants and PRO firms: https://gettawsiya.com/en/partners/

## What Tawsiya does not claim
Tawsiya does not guarantee rankings or first place in AI answers. Each assistant decides on its own and answers change over time; progress is shown by asking the same questions every week.
Example figures and business names on the home page are illustrations; the free report and client dashboards use real checks.

## FAQ
- **What does Tawsiya do?** We check what ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity say when your customers ask for a business like yours. Then we fix what stops them from naming you: your website, Google profile, listings, reviews and business facts. Every week we ask again, so you can see what changed.
- **Is the free report really free?** Yes. No card and no account. Paste your website and in a few minutes you get your score out of 100, the real answers, the competitors named instead of you, and a list of fixes.
- **Do you guarantee AI will recommend me?** No, and nobody honest can. Each assistant decides on its own and answers change over time. What we stand behind is the work: clear fixes, done or explained, and the same questions asked again every week so progress is measured, not guessed.
- **How soon will I see a difference?** Website and profile fixes can show within a few weeks. Listings and reviews usually take one to three months. Your weekly scan shows each change as it happens.
- **What is the difference between Track and Grow?** Track (AED 199 a month) measures you every week and gives you a step-by-step plan you carry out yourself. Grow (AED 799 a month) is done for you: our team makes the fixes, tracks more questions and competitors, and reviews progress with you on WhatsApp every month.
- **Will I be charged automatically?** No. Plans are paid one month at a time through Ziina and never renew by themselves. We remind you 7 days and 1 day before your month ends, and you decide whether to continue.
- **Do you work in Arabic and English?** Yes. We ask AI the way your customers do, in Arabic and in English, and your report and dashboard work in both languages.
- **Which businesses is it for?** Any UAE business that customers look for: clinics, restaurants and cafés, real estate, salons and spas, and professional services. If people ask AI for the best place like yours in Dubai, it is for you.
- **What happens to my data?** We read only your public website and public listings. Your report is a private link, and we never sell or share your data.
